its joint4 control. This known training repair is not the core method.
C Self-draft mixing repairs much of the gap

Real frozen Qwen + observed RGB-D; same architecture and data.
Strict target identity + 3 cm threshold. Conventional baseline repair;
full-path validity and independent confirmation remain unmeasured.
D Grounding repair improves three training seeds

g.text: Measured baseline repairs; a stable task-level route-set mechanism remains unproved.
A–C: oracle-geometry controlled tier. D: observed RGB-D + language + current state. All panels use DEV-selected checkpoints; no locked-test claim.
Training costs with different thread counts or cached/live encoding scopes are not compared in this figure.
